ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Usage Of Qemu
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Qemu utility in a Windows environment.
Threat actors have leveraged this utility and this technique for achieving network access as reported by Kaspersky.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-m\\ 1M.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-m\\ 2M.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-m\\ 3M.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*restrict\\=off.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-netdev\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*connect\\=.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-nographic.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-cdrom\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ type\\=virt\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-blockdev\\ .*")))
